name: Tribunal of Milan, judgment no. 3364/2021 – PM10 compensation

jurisdiction.court: Tribunal of Milan (Tribunale ordinario di Milano)

description: Application under Article 702-bis of the Code of Civil Procedure by a Milanese citizen against the Municipality of Milan and the Lombardy Region for compensation for damage to health and to social life resulting from the continuous and systematic exceedances of the PM10 limit values found by the CJEU (C-644/18) and attributable to the failure to adopt adequate measures under Legislative Decree no. 155/2010.
outcome: The Tribunal declared that it lacked jurisdiction, holding that the dispute was reserved to the administrative court (Article 7 of the Code of Administrative Procedure). Subsequently the Regional Administrative Court for Lombardy (TAR Lombardia) (order 1208/2022) raised a negative conflict of jurisdiction before the Joint Divisions, which, by order no. 5668/2023, affirmed the jurisdiction of the ordinary court. The first true Italian compensation case for air pollution.
